children: BROOKLYN, NY / ACCESS Newswire / September 2, 2026 / IEH Corporation (OTCQX:IEHC) announced today that in the last two weeks it has received $6.5 million worth of orders for its Hyperboloid connectors in support of the APKWS program, raising its backlog to over $45 million, nearly triple the level at this time last year.

Dave Offerman, President and CEO of IEH Corporation commented, "These orders, on top of an already historically high backlog, reflect the extraordinary demand for the high-performance Hyperboloid connectors we supply to our nation's critical missile and air defense systems. The APKWS program is a major component of our nation's precision-guided missile arsenal, and IEH has been a critical supplier for this program since its inception.

Along with PATRIOT, THAAD and many other missile and missile-defense systems, APKWS employs IEH's signature Hyperboloid connectors to ensure reliability and durability in today's battlefields. As these programs continue to experience unprecedented demand, IEH will continue to increase capacity and ramp up production to meet our nation's defense needs."

For over 85 years and 4 generations of family-run management, IEH Corporation has designed, developed, and manufactured printed circuit board (PCB) connectors, custom interconnects and contacts for high-performance applications. With its signature Hyperboloid technology, IEH supplies the most durable, reliable connectors for the most demanding environments. The Company markets primarily to companies in defense, aerospace, medical, space and industrial applications, in the United States, Canada, Europe, Southeast and Central Asia and the Mideast. The Company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, New York.
